description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the 19th century during the Victorian era. The book chronicles the tumultuous period in the Netherlands following the assassination of William the Silent, emphasizing the struggle for independence against Spanish rule, as well as the political and military developments that unfolded during the Eighty Years' War.
